title: Tarjima va ikki tilli fikrlash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz o‘zbekcha matnni so‘zma-so‘z emas, ma’no bo‘yicha inglizchaga o‘girasiz, o‘nlab “soxta do‘st” so‘zlarni ajratasiz, maqol va murojaatlarni madaniyatga moslaysiz hamda tarjimasiz, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri inglizcha fikrlash usullarini qo‘llaysiz.

vocab.uz: soxta do‘st (shakli o‘xshash, ma’nosi boshqa so‘z)

scenes.title: Ikki til orasida
board: Strategies · False friends · Culture · Thinking in English
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ommaviy nutq va debatni o‘rgandik: nutq tuzilmasi, raddiya va ishonchli yetkazish. Bugun ikki til orasidagi ko‘prik haqida gaplashamiz. Dars oxirida siz ma’no bo‘yicha tarjima qilasiz, soxta do‘st so‘zlardan qochasiz, maqol va murojaatlarni madaniyatga moslaysiz va boshingizda tarjima qilmasdan inglizcha fikrlash usullarini bilasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Today we live between two languages: translating meaning rather than words, spotting false friends, adapting culture, and learning to think in English without a detour through Uzbek.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Bugun ikki til orasida yashaymiz: so‘zlarni emas, ma’noni tarjima qilish, soxta do‘stlarni tanish, madaniyatni moslash va o‘zbek tili orqali aylanib o‘tmasdan inglizcha fikrlashni o‘rganish.

scenes.title: So‘zni emas, ma’noni
board: Unit of translation = phrase / sentence, not word
Ask: What would an English speaker SAY here?
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi tarjimaning birinchi qoidasi: so‘zni emas, ma’noni o‘giring. Tarjima birligi so‘z emas, ibora yoki butun jumla. Har safar o‘zingizga savol bering: shu vaziyatda ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchi nima degan bo‘lardi? “Osh bo‘lsin” ni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girish kulgili chiqadi, vaziyatga mos ibora esa “Enjoy your meal”. Haddan tashqari erkin tarjima ham xavfli: ma’no o‘zgarib ketmasligi kerak.
scenes.say: A good translation doesn’t sound like a translation. It sounds like something an English speaker would actually say in that situation.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi tarjima tarjimaga o‘xshamaydi. U ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchi o‘sha vaziyatda haqiqatan aytadigan gapga o‘xshaydi.

scenes.title: Transpozitsiya va modulyatsiya
board: Uning kelishi hammani quvontirdi → Everyone was delighted when he arrived.
Modulation: change the point of view

examples.t: It’s not cheap. → Bu ancha qimmat.

scenes.say_native: Ikki muhim usul. Transpozitsiya — so‘z turkumini almashtirish: o‘zbekchadagi “uning kelishi” kabi harakat nomi inglizchada ko‘pincha ergash gapga aylanadi: “when he arrived”. Modulyatsiya — nuqtai nazarni o‘zgartirish: “Yo‘qolib ketmang” salbiy shaklda, inglizcha muqobili esa ijobiy: “Keep in touch”. Ingliz tili ko‘pincha fe’l bilan, o‘zbek tili esa ot va sifatdosh bilan fikrlaydi, shuning uchun bu usullar sizga har kuni kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Everyone was delighted when he arrived. Keep in touch! Notice that neither sentence copies the Uzbek grammar, yet both carry exactly the same meaning.
scenes.say_uz: U kelganida hamma xursand bo‘ldi. Yo‘qolib ketmang! E’tibor bering, ikkala jumla ham o‘zbekcha grammatikani ko‘chirmaydi, lekin aynan bir xil ma’noni beradi.

scenes.title: Grammatik farqlarni to‘ldirish
board: Kitobni oldim. → I bought the book. (article)
…yildan beri ishlayman → I’ve been working… for

examples.t: Men bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlayman. → I’ve been working here for three years.
examples.uz: Present simple emas, present perfect continuous

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida yo‘q, lekin inglizchada majburiy bo‘lgan narsalarni tarjimada qo‘shishingiz kerak. Birinchi, ega: “Keldim” bir so‘z, inglizchada esa “I’ve arrived”. Ikkinchi, jins: “u” olmoshi he, she yoki it bo‘lishi mumkin, siz tanlashingiz shart. Uchinchi, artikl: tushum kelishigidagi “kitobni” ko‘pincha “the book” bo‘ladi. To‘rtinchi, zamon: “uch yildan beri ishlayman” hozirgi zamonda, lekin inglizchada present perfect continuous kerak.
scenes.say: I’ve been working here for three years. She called, but I missed it. I bought the book you recommended. Every one of these needs something Uzbek leaves out.
scenes.say_uz: Men bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlayman. U qo‘ng‘iroq qildi, lekin men eshitmay qoldim. Siz tavsiya qilgan kitobni sotib oldim. Har birida o‘zbek tili tushirib qoldiradigan narsa kerak.

scenes.title: Uzun jumlani bo‘lish
board: English: shorter clauses, linked by and / then / after
Ishga kelib, kompyuterni yoqib, xatlarni tekshirdim.
→ I got to work, switched on my computer and checked my email.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida bir jumlaga ko‘plab “-ib”, “-gan”, “-gach” qo‘shimchali ravishdosh va sifatdoshlarni tizish mumkin, fe’l esa oxirida keladi. Inglizchada bunday zanjir og‘ir va noaniq eshitiladi. Shuning uchun uni alohida fe’llarga ajrating va “and”, “then”, “after” bilan bog‘lang yoki hatto ikki jumlaga bo‘ling. Ingliz o‘quvchisi asosiy fe’lni erta ko‘rishni kutadi: ega va kesim jumlaning boshida bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: I got to work, switched on my computer and checked my email. Then, once the meeting was over, I finally had lunch. Short clauses, verbs early, and the reader never gets lost.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga keldim, kompyuterni yoqdim va xatlarni tekshirdim. Keyin, yig‘ilish tugagach, nihoyat tushlik qildim. Qisqa gaplar, fe’l oldinda, o‘quvchi hech qachon adashmaydi.

scenes.title: Kalka xatolari
board: ✓ I’ve been working here for three years.
✗ My boss is great. It always helps me.
scenes.say_native: Kalka — boshqa tilning tuzilmasini so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirish. Birinchi tipik xato: zamonni o‘zbekchadan ko‘chirish: “I work here three years”. To‘g‘risi: “I’ve been working here for three years”. Ikkinchisi: “u” olmoshini o‘ylamasdan “it” yoki noto‘g‘ri jins bilan tarjima qilish; odam uchun “it” qo‘pol eshitiladi. Uchinchisi: artiklni tashlab ketish: “Teacher said” emas, “The teacher said”. Tarjimani tugatgach, aynan shu uch nuqtani tekshiring.
scenes.say: Check three things in every translation: tense, pronouns and articles. They are exactly where Uzbek grammar quietly leaks into your English.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir tarjimada uch narsani tekshiring: zamon, olmoshlar va artikllar. Aynan shu joylarda o‘zbek grammatikasi inglizchangizga sezdirmay sizib kiradi.

scenes.title: Ma’no bo‘yicha o‘giring
board: 1) Bu shaharda besh yildan beri yashayman.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rt jumlani inglizchaga o‘giring. Birinchisida zamonga, ikkinchisida ravishdosh zanjiriga, uchinchisida modulyatsiyaga, to‘rtinchisida esa harakat nomiga e’tibor bering. To‘rtinchi jumlada “u” kim ekanini bilmaymiz, shuning uchun he yoki she ni o‘zingiz tanlang. Javobni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Translate the four sentences. Think about tense, about breaking the chain, about point of view, and about turning a noun into a clause.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt jumlani tarjima qiling. Zamon, zanjirni bo‘lish, nuqtai nazar va otni ergash gapga aylantirish haqida o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tarjima
board: 1) I’ve lived / been living in this city for five years.
2) When I got to work, I had a cup of tea.
3) Keep in touch! / Don’t be a stranger!
4) Everyone was surprised when she arrived.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I’ve lived in this city for five years” yoki “I’ve been living”. Ikkinchi: “When I got to work, I had a cup of tea”; “Having got to work” ham mumkin, lekin og‘irroq. Uchinchi: “Keep in touch!” yoki norasmiy “Don’t be a stranger!”. To‘rtinchi: “Everyone was surprised when she arrived”; “Her arrival surprised everyone” ham to‘g‘ri, lekin rasmiyroq. Ko‘rib turibsizki, bitta to‘g‘ri javob yo‘q, lekin so‘zma-so‘z javob deyarli doim noto‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: I’ve lived in this city for five years. When I got to work, I had a cup of tea. Keep in touch! Everyone was surprised when she arrived.
scenes.say_uz: Bu shaharda besh yildan beri yashayman. Ishga kelgach, bir piyola choy ichdim. Yo‘qolib ketmang! U kelganida hamma hayron qoldi.

scenes.title: Soxta do‘stlar nima?
board: False friends = similar form, different meaning
Often via Russian: magazin, kabinet, familiya
scenes.say_native: Soxta do‘stlar — shakli o‘xshash, lekin ma’nosi boshqa so‘zlar. O‘zbek tiliga ko‘p xalqaro so‘zlar rus tili orqali kirgan, shuning uchun aynan ular eng xavfli. “Magazin” bizda do‘kon, inglizcha “magazine” esa jurnal. “Kabinet” — xona yoki ish xonasi, “cabinet” esa shkaf yoki hukumat vazirlar mahkamasi. “Familiya” — “surname”, “familiar” esa “tanish”. “Prospekt” — “avenue”, “prospect” esa “istiqbol, imkoniyat”.
scenes.say: I bought it at the shop, not the magazine. Come to my office, not my cabinet. My surname is Karimov. And Navoi Avenue, not Navoi prospect.
scenes.say_uz: Uni jurnalda emas, do‘konda sotib oldim. Shkafimga emas, ish xonamga keling. Familiyam Karimov. Va Navoiy prospekti, inglizchada Navoi Avenue.

scenes.title: C2 darajadagi soxta do‘stlar

examples.t: The actual cost was much higher than the estimate.
examples.uz: Haqiqiy xarajat taxmindan ancha yuqori bo‘ldi.

scenes.say_native: Yuqori darajada ham adashtiradigan so‘zlar. “Actual” — haqiqiy, “actually” — aslida. “Aktual” ma’nosi uchun “topical”, “relevant” yoki “pressing” ishlating. “Sympathetic” — hamdard, tushunadigan; “simpatichniy” uchun “attractive” yoki “nice-looking”. “Accurate” — aniq, to‘g‘ri; “akkurat” uchun “neat” yoki “tidy”. “Fabric” — mato, zavod esa “factory”. Bu so‘zlar grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri gap ichida turib ham ma’noni butunlay buzadi, shuning uchun ular ayniqsa xavfli.
scenes.say: The actual cost was higher than expected. She was very sympathetic when I lost my job. His figures were accurate, and his desk was neat. Four pairs, four traps.
scenes.say_uz: Haqiqiy xarajat kutilganidan yuqori bo‘ldi. Ishimni yo‘qotganimda u menga juda hamdard bo‘ldi. Uning raqamlari aniq, stoli esa toza-ozoda edi. To‘rt juftlik, to‘rt tuzoq.

scenes.title: Qisman soxta do‘stlar
board: scandal = public outrage (≠ a row, a quarrel)
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi so‘zlar qisman mos keladi, bu esa ularni yanada xavfli qiladi. “Realise” asosan “anglab yetmoq” degani; “realise an ambition” kabi birikma bor, lekin loyihani amalga oshirish uchun “implement” yoki “carry out” kerak. “Scandal” — jamiyatni g‘azablantirgan janjal, oddiy urushish esa “a row” yoki “an argument”. “Academic” — olim, akademik unvon esa “academician”. “Decade” — o‘n yil, “dekada” kabi o‘n kun emas.
scenes.say: I suddenly realised I’d left my keys at home. We plan to implement the project next year. My neighbours had a terrible row last night. That was a decade ago.
scenes.say_uz: To‘satdan kalitlarimni uyda qoldirganimni angladim. Loyihani kelasi yili amalga oshirishni rejalashtiryapmiz. Kecha qo‘shnilarim qattiq janjallashdi. Bu o‘n yil oldin edi.

scenes.title: Soxta do‘st tuzog‘i
board: ✓ This issue is very topical / pressing.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: “This problem is very actual”. Ingliz o‘quvchisi buni “bu muammo juda haqiqiy” deb tushunadi va nima demoqchi ekaningizni anglamaydi. To‘g‘risi: “This issue is very topical” yoki “pressing”. Ikkinchi xato kulgili vaziyatga olib keladi: birovni chiroyli demoqchi bo‘lib “sympathetic” desangiz, u “hamdard” degan ma’noni beradi. Bunday so‘zlarda doim bir tilli lug‘atni tekshiring.
scenes.say: This issue is very topical. She is very attractive, and, as it happens, very sympathetic too. Two different compliments.
scenes.say_uz: Bu masala juda dolzarb. U juda jozibali, va shuningdek, juda hamdard ham. Ikki xil maqtov.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 1) We had a big scandal with my neighbour yesterday.
2) I want to realise my project next year.
4) Climate change is a very actual problem.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt jumlaning har birida bittadan soxta do‘st bor. Uni toping va to‘g‘ri so‘z bilan almashtiring. Esingizda bo‘lsin: ba’zi jumlalarda grammatika to‘g‘ri, xato faqat ma’noda. Har jumlani to‘g‘rilab, ovoz chiqarib ayting. Agar biror so‘zga shubha qilsangiz, uni rus tilidagi ma’nosi bilan solishtirib ko‘ring: xato ko‘pincha o‘sha yerdan keladi.
scenes.say: Each sentence hides one false friend. Find it and fix it.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir jumlada bitta soxta do‘st yashiringan. Uni toping va tuzating.

scenes.title: Javoblar: soxta do‘stlar
board: 1) a big row / argument with my neighbour
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “scandal” emas, “a row” yoki “an argument”: “We had a big row with our neighbour”. Ikkinchi: “realise” emas, “implement” yoki “carry out my project”. Uchinchi: “My surname is Rahimova”; “familiar” — tanish degani. To‘rtinchi: “actual” emas, “pressing” yoki “topical”. Bu so‘zlarni shaxsiy ro‘yxatingizga yozing: har bir xatoni ikki marta qilmaslik uchun.
scenes.say: We had a big row with our neighbour yesterday. I want to carry out my project next year. My surname is Rahimova. Climate change is a pressing problem.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha qo‘shnimiz bilan qattiq janjallashdik. Loyihamni kelasi yili amalga oshirmoqchiman. Familiyam Rahimova. Iqlim o‘zgarishi dolzarb muammo.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tarjimani tahrir qilish
board: Listening 1: Dilnoza and her editor, Mark
A company brochure translated into English
scenes.say_native: Endi suhbatni tinglang. Dilnoza kompaniya bukletini inglizchaga tarjima qilgan, muharrir Mark esa unga fikr bildiryapti. Uchta tuzatishni eshitishga harakat qiling: qaysi so‘z noto‘g‘ri va uning o‘rniga nima tavsiya qilinadi. Shuningdek, Mark tarjimaga umuman qanday baho berganini va Dilnoza oxirida nima qilishga va’da berganini kuzating.
scenes.say: Mark: I’ve read your translation. It’s accurate, but a few things jump out. Dilnoza: Go on. Mark: You’ve written ‘the most actual information’. We’d say ‘the most up-to-date’. Dilnoza: Ah, another false friend. Mark: And ‘our fabric was founded in 1995’. A fabric is cloth; you mean factory. Dilnoza: Of course. Anything else? Mark: ‘Welcome to our cabinet’ sounds like a cupboard. Try ‘our office’. Dilnoza: That’s so helpful. I’ll add them to my list.
scenes.say_uz: Mark: Tarjimangizni o‘qidim. Aniq chiqqan, lekin bir nechta narsa ko‘zga tashlanadi. Dilnoza: Davom eting. Mark: Siz “eng aktual ma’lumot” deb yozibsiz. Biz “eng yangi ma’lumot” deymiz. Dilnoza: Voy, yana bir soxta do‘st. Mark: Va “bizning matomiz 1995-yilda tashkil topgan”. Fabric — mato, siz zavodni nazarda tutgansiz. Dilnoza: Albatta. Yana nima? Mark: “Shkafimizga xush kelibsiz” bo‘lib eshitiladi. “Ofisimizga” deb ko‘ring. Dilnoza: Juda foydali bo‘ldi. Ularni ro‘yxatimga qo‘shaman.

scenes.title: Suhbatni tushunish
board: 1) What does Mark think of the translation overall?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Mark tarjimaga umuman qanday baho berdi? Qaysi uchta so‘z tuzatildi va ular o‘rniga nima tavsiya qilindi? Dilnoza oxirida nima qilishini aytdi? E’tibor bering, Markning birinchi jumlasida ham bizga tanish so‘z bor, u qaysi ma’noda ishlatildi?
scenes.say: What does Mark think of the translation overall? What are the three corrections? And what will Dilnoza do next?
scenes.say_uz: Mark tarjimaga umuman qanday baho beradi? Uchta tuzatish nima? Va Dilnoza keyin nima qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat
board: 2) actual → up-to-date · fabric → factory · cabinet → office
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mark tarjimani “accurate”, ya’ni aniq deb baholadi, bu so‘z bu yerda to‘g‘ri, inglizcha ma’nosida ishlatilgan. Uch tuzatish: “actual” o‘rniga “up-to-date”, “fabric” o‘rniga “factory”, “cabinet” o‘rniga “office”. Dilnoza ularni shaxsiy ro‘yxatiga qo‘shishini aytdi. Bu professional tarjimonlarning odati: har bir soxta do‘st bir marta xato, keyin esa ro‘yxatda.
scenes.say: Accurate, but with three false friends: up-to-date, not actual; factory, not fabric; office, not cabinet. And straight onto her list.
scenes.say_uz: Aniq, lekin uchta soxta do‘st bilan: actual emas, up-to-date; fabric emas, factory; cabinet emas, office. Va darhol ro‘yxatga.

scenes.title: Soxta do‘stlarga qarshi tizim
board: If it looks like Russian, double-check
scenes.say_native: Soxta do‘stlardan qutulishning tizimi bor. Birinchi, shaxsiy ro‘yxat yuriting: so‘z, noto‘g‘ri ma’no, to‘g‘ri muqobil va bitta misol. Ikkinchi, ikki tilli emas, bir tilli lug‘atdan foydalaning: Oxford yoki Cambridge lug‘ati so‘zni inglizcha izohlaydi va misol beradi. Uchinchi, so‘zni real gaplarda ko‘ring: qaysi so‘zlar bilan birga kelishini tekshiring. Oddiy qoida: agar inglizcha so‘z ruscha yoki o‘zbekcha so‘zga juda o‘xshasa, albatta tekshiring.
scenes.say: If an English word looks suspiciously like a Russian one, treat it as guilty until proven innocent. Check a monolingual dictionary and look at real examples.
scenes.say_uz: Agar inglizcha so‘z ruscha so‘zga shubhali darajada o‘xshasa, aybsizligi isbotlanmaguncha uni aybdor deb hisoblang. Bir tilli lug‘atni tekshiring va real misollarga qarang.

scenes.title: Madaniy moslash: maqollar
board: Find an equivalent, not a copy
Sabr tagi — sariq oltin → Good things come to those who wait.
Tuyaning dumi yerga tekkanda → when pigs fly
No equivalent? → explain the meaning plainly
scenes.say_native: Maqol va iboralarni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girish deyarli doim muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘ladi. Avval ingliz tilida shunga o‘xshash ma’noli ibora bormi, qidiring. “Sabr tagi — sariq oltin” uchun “Good things come to those who wait” yaxshi muqobil. “Tuyaning dumi yerga tekkanda” — “when pigs fly”. Agar muqobil bo‘lmasa, ma’noni oddiy so‘zlar bilan bering. Badiiy matnda esa ba’zan asl obrazni saqlab, izoh bilan berish ham mumkin.
scenes.say: Good things come to those who wait. He’ll pay you back when pigs fly. Different animals, different images, the same idea.
scenes.say_uz: Sabr tagi — sariq oltin. U qarzini tuyaning dumi yerga tekkanda qaytaradi. Boshqa hayvonlar, boshqa obrazlar, lekin bir xil g‘oya.

scenes.title: Murojaat va hurmat shakllari
board: Hurmatli Karim aka → Dear Mr Karimov / Dear Karim
domla, opa, aka → usually dropped or a title
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida hurmat “siz” olmoshi va “aka”, “opa”, “domla” kabi so‘zlar bilan bildiriladi. Ingliz tilida “you” bitta, shuning uchun hurmat boshqa vositalar bilan beriladi: “Mr”, “Dr” kabi unvonlar va “Could you possibly…”, “Would you mind…” kabi modal iboralar bilan. “Aka” va “opa” odatda tushib qoladi. Yana bir mayda tuzoq: “07/11/2026” Britaniyada 7-noyabr, Amerikada esa 11-iyul deb o‘qiladi, shuning uchun sanani so‘z bilan yozing.
scenes.say: Dear Dr Rakhimova, could you possibly send me the report by 7 November? Politeness lives in the verbs, not in the pronoun.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli doktor Rahimova, hisobotni 7-noyabrgacha yubora olasizmi? Xushmuomalalik olmoshda emas, fe’llarda yashaydi.

scenes.title: Uslub va hajm
board: Uzbek formal letter: long greeting, praise, wishes
English business email: purpose in line one
Sizga chuqur hurmat bilan murojaat qilaman… → I’m writing to…
Keep the facts, adapt the frame
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy o‘zbek xati ko‘pincha uzun salomlashuv, maqtov va tilaklar bilan boshlanadi. Uni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girsangiz, ingliz o‘quvchisi asosiy gapni topolmaydi va matn haddan ortiq tantanali tuyuladi. Ingliz ish xatida maqsad birinchi qatorda aytiladi: “I’m writing to ask about…”. Qoida: faktlar va iltimosni saqlang, ramkani esa o‘quvchi madaniyatiga moslang. Bu mazmunni buzish emas, uni to‘g‘ri yetkazish.
scenes.say: Dear Ms Taylor, I’m writing to ask whether your team could join our conference in March. Purpose first, courtesy in the tone, and nothing the reader has to dig for.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli Teylor xonim, jamoangiz mart oyidagi konferensiyamizda qatnasha oladimi, shuni so‘rash uchun yozyapman. Avval maqsad, xushmuomalalik ohangda va o‘quvchi qidirishi kerak bo‘lgan hech narsa yo‘q.

scenes.title: Iborani so‘zma-so‘z o‘girish
board: ✗ May your hands not see pain!
scenes.say_native: Iboralarni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girish kulgili yoki tushunarsiz natija beradi. “Boshim osmonga yetdi” ni “My head reached the sky” desangiz, ingliz tinglovchisi hayron bo‘ladi; muqobili — “I was over the moon”. “Qo‘lingiz dard ko‘rmasin” iborasining ingliz tilida aniq muqobili yo‘q, shuning uchun vaziyatga qarab minnatdorchilik bildiring: “Thank you, that was delicious”. Obraz yo‘qoladi, lekin vazifasi, ya’ni minnatdorchilik saqlanadi.
scenes.say: When I got the job, I was over the moon. And after a wonderful dinner: thank you so much, that was absolutely delicious.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga qabul qilinganimda boshim osmonga yetdi. Ajoyib kechki ovqatdan keyin esa: qo‘lingiz dard ko‘rmasin, juda mazali bo‘libdi.

scenes.title: Madaniyatga moslang
scenes.say_native: To‘rt iborani ingliz tiliga madaniy jihatdan moslab o‘giring. So‘zma-so‘z emas, vazifasini saqlang: minnatdorchilik, quvonch, omadni “cho‘chitmaslik” va rasmiy murojaat. Uchinchi ibora uchun inglizlarda ham shunday irim bor, uni eslashga harakat qiling. Javoblarni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Adapt these four for an English speaker. Keep the function: thanks, joy, a little superstition, and a polite opening.
scenes.say_uz: Bu to‘rttasini ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchi uchun moslang. Vazifasini saqlang: minnatdorchilik, quvonch, ozgina irim va xushmuomala boshlanish.

scenes.title: Javoblar: madaniy moslash
board: 2) I passed! I’m over the moon!
3) So far so good, touch wood. (US: knock on wood)
4) Dear Professor Aliyev, / Dear Dr Aliyev,
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Thank you, that was delicious!” Ikkinchi: “I passed! I’m over the moon!” Uchinchi: inglizlar ham omadni cho‘chitmaslik uchun yog‘ochga taqillatadi: Britaniyada “touch wood”, Amerikada “knock on wood”. To‘rtinchi: “domla” so‘zining aniq muqobili yo‘q, shuning uchun unvon ishlatiladi: “Dear Professor Aliyev” yoki “Dear Dr Aliyev”, unvon bo‘lmasa “Dear Mr Aliyev”.
scenes.say: Thank you, that was delicious! I passed, I’m over the moon! So far so good, touch wood. Dear Professor Aliyev.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘lingiz dard ko‘rmasin, juda mazali edi! O‘tdim, boshim osmonga yetdi! Hozircha hammasi yaxshi, ko‘z tegmasin. Hurmatli professor Aliyev.

scenes.title: Tinglash: sayyohlik sayti
board: Listen for: the proverb, dasturxon, prices
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat. Tarjimon Aziz va muharrir Claire O‘zbekiston haqidagi sayyohlik saytini ingliz tiliga moslash haqida gaplashyapti. Uchta qarorga e’tibor bering: “Mehmon otangdan ulug‘” maqoli bilan nima qilindi, “dasturxon” so‘zi qanday berildi va narxlar bilan bog‘liq qanday qaror qabul qilindi. Har bir qarorning sababini ham eshiting.
scenes.say: Claire: How did you handle the proverb about guests? Aziz: Literally, it says a guest is greater than your father. In English that sounds odd, even a little shocking. Claire: So what did you write? Aziz: ‘In Uzbekistan, guests are treated like royalty.’ Claire: Nice. And dasturxon? Aziz: I kept the word in italics and explained it once: a spread of food laid out for guests. Claire: And the prices? Aziz: Converted into dollars, with a date, because exchange rates change.
scenes.say_uz: Claire: Mehmon haqidagi maqolni qanday hal qildingiz? Aziz: So‘zma-so‘z u mehmon otangdan ulug‘ deydi. Inglizchada bu g‘alati, hatto biroz hayratlanarli eshitiladi. Claire: Unda nima yozdingiz? Aziz: “O‘zbekistonda mehmonni podshohdek kutishadi.” Claire: Zo‘r. Dasturxon-chi? Aziz: So‘zni kursivda qoldirdim va bir marta izohladim: mehmonlar uchun yoyilgan taomlar. Claire: Narxlar-chi? Aziz: Dollarga o‘girdim, sanasi bilan, chunki valyuta kursi o‘zgaradi.

scenes.title: Qarorlarni tushuntiring
board: 1) Why not translate the proverb literally?
4) Why add a date to the prices?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Nega maqol so‘zma-so‘z o‘girilmadi? Aziz o‘rniga nima yozdi? “Dasturxon” so‘zi bilan nima qildi? Narxlarga nega sana qo‘shildi? Har bir javobda tarjimonning qaysi strategiyani tanlaganini ham ayting: muqobil topish, so‘zni saqlab izohlash yoki ma’lumotni moslash.
scenes.say: Why not translate the proverb literally? What did Aziz write? How did he handle dasturxon? And why the date on the prices?
scenes.say_uz: Nega maqol so‘zma-so‘z o‘girilmadi? Aziz nima yozdi? Dasturxonni qanday hal qildi? Va narxlarga nega sana qo‘yildi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: lokalizatsiya
board: 3) kept the word + one explanation (borrowing + gloss)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: so‘zma-so‘z tarjima g‘alati, hatto hayratlanarli eshitiladi. Ikkinchi: “guests are treated like royalty” — ma’nosi bir xil ibora, ya’ni muqobil. Uchinchi: “dasturxon” saqlandi va bir marta izohlandi, bu o‘zlashtirish va izoh strategiyasi. Shu tarzda madaniy rang saqlanadi. To‘rtinchi: valyuta kursi o‘zgaradi, shuning uchun sana ma’lumotni aniq qiladi. Lokalizatsiya — faqat til emas, o‘quvchining ehtiyoji haqida ham o‘ylash.
scenes.say: An equivalent for the proverb, a borrowing with a gloss for dasturxon, and adapted information for the prices. Three problems, three different strategies.
scenes.say_uz: Maqol uchun muqobil, dasturxon uchun izohli o‘zlashtirma va narxlar uchun moslangan ma’lumot. Uchta muammo, uchta turli strategiya.

scenes.title: Nega inglizcha fikrlash kerak
board: Uzbek thought → translation → English = slow + calques
Goal at C2: translate only when you choose to
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘rtinchi mavzu. Agar har bir gapni avval o‘zbekcha o‘ylab, keyin tarjima qilsangiz, ikki muammo paydo bo‘ladi: nutq sekinlashadi va kalkalar ko‘payadi. C2 darajasidagi maqsad — fikrdan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri inglizchaga o‘tish. Tarjima esa sizning ongli tanlovingiz bo‘lsin: hujjat yoki matn ustida ishlaganda, gapirayotganda emas. Bu tug‘ma qobiliyat emas, mashq bilan shakllanadigan odat.
scenes.say: Translation is a skill you use on purpose, at a desk. Conversation is something else: idea in, English out, with no Uzbek stopover in between.
scenes.say_uz: Tarjima — stol ustida ataylab ishlatiladigan mahorat. Suhbat esa boshqa narsa: fikr kiradi, inglizcha chiqadi, oradagi o‘zbekcha bekatsiz.

scenes.title: So‘zlarni emas, bo‘laklarni o‘rganing
board: qaror qabul qilmoq → make / take a decision
imtihon topshirmoq → take / sit an exam

examples.t: I sat three exams last week and made one silly mistake.
examples.uz: O‘tgan hafta uchta imtihon topshirdim va bitta bema’ni xato qildim.

scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri fikrlashning asosi — alohida so‘zlarni emas, tayyor bo‘laklarni, ya’ni kollokatsiyalarni o‘rganish. O‘zbekcha “qaror qabul qilmoq” dan “accept a decision” chiqadi, lekin inglizlar “make” yoki Britaniyada “take a decision” deydi. “E’tibor bermoq” — “pay attention”, “give” emas. “Imtihon topshirmoq” — “take” yoki Britaniyada “sit an exam”; “pass” esa imtihondan o‘tish degani. Bo‘lakni butunligicha eslasangiz, tarjimaga hojat qolmaydi.
scenes.say: I sat three exams last week and made one silly mistake. Pay attention to the verb: in English, you make a decision, you pay attention, you take a photo.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan hafta uchta imtihon topshirdim va bitta bema’ni xato qildim. Fe’lga e’tibor bering: inglizchada qaror make qilinadi, e’tibor pay qilinadi, surat take qilinadi.

scenes.title: Bilmasangiz, tasvirlang
board: It’s a kind of… / It’s similar to…
It’s the thing you use to…
It’s what you call a person who…
scenes.say_native: Gapirayotganda so‘z esdan chiqsa, o‘zbekchaga qaytmang va to‘xtab ham qolmang. Uni tasvirlang. “It’s a kind of…” — bu bir turdagi…; “It’s the thing you use to…” — bu … uchun ishlatiladigan narsa; “It’s what you call a person who…” — … qiladigan odamni shunday atashadi. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham buni doim qiladi. Bu mahorat sizni tarjimaga qaramlikdan qutqaradi va C2 imtihonlarida ham yuqori baholanadi.
scenes.say: It’s the thing you use to squeeze the juice out of a lemon. Oh, a lemon squeezer! See? You got there without a dictionary and without a single word of Uzbek.
scenes.say_uz: Bu limondan sharbat siqib olish uchun ishlatiladigan narsa. A, limon siqgich! Ko‘rdingizmi? Lug‘atsiz va bitta ham o‘zbekcha so‘zsiz yetib keldingiz.

scenes.title: Ichki ovozni inglizchaga o‘tkazish
board: Narrate your day silently in English
Talk to yourself: What do I need? Where are my keys?
Plan in English before you speak or write
scenes.say_native: Inglizcha fikrlash kundalik odat bilan shakllanadi. Kuningizni ichingizda inglizcha sharhlang: “Now I’m making tea, the kettle’s nearly boiled”. O‘zingiz bilan inglizcha gaplashing. Telefoningiz tilini o‘zgartiring, ovqat pishirish yoki sport paytini “faqat inglizcha” vaqt qiling. Eng muhimi, insho yoki nutqni o‘zbekcha rejalashtirib, keyin tarjima qilmang: rejani boshidanoq inglizcha tuzing. Bir oyda farqni sezasiz.
scenes.say: Right, I’m running late. Keys, phone, wallet. Where did I put my glasses? Ah, on my head, of course. Little moments like this are perfect practice.
scenes.say_uz: Xo‘sh, kechikyapman. Kalitlar, telefon, hamyon. Ko‘zoynagimni qayerga qo‘ydim? A, boshimda ekan, albatta. Bunday kichik lahzalar ajoyib mashq.

scenes.title: Fe’l kalkalari
board: ✗ I accepted a decision. ✓ I made a decision.
✗ I did a mistake. ✓ I made a mistake.
✗ I passed the exam tomorrow. ✓ I’m taking the exam tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: Tarjima qilib fikrlashning eng aniq izi — fe’l kalkalari. “Accept a decision” — o‘zbekcha “qabul qilmoq” dan; inglizcha “accept a decision” boshqa odam qarorini qabul qilish degani. “Give attention” emas, “pay attention”. “Do a mistake” emas, “make a mistake”. Eng nozigi: “imtihon topshiraman” ni “I’ll pass the exam” deyish. “Pass” — muvaffaqiyatli o‘tish; hali natija noma’lum bo‘lsa, “take” yoki “sit” deng.
scenes.say: I’m taking my exam tomorrow, and I really hope I pass it. Take is the attempt; pass is the success.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga imtihon topshiraman va undan o‘tishga juda umid qilaman. Take — urinish, pass — muvaffaqiyat.

scenes.title: Bo‘laklarni ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi tez mashq. Har bir o‘zbekcha birikma uchun inglizcha bo‘lakni tarjima qilmasdan, avtomatik aytishga harakat qiling. Fe’lga alohida e’tibor bering: make, take, pay, do yoki have? Keyin har biri bilan qisqa gap tuzing. Bitta so‘z uchun bir nechta to‘g‘ri variant bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin fe’lni o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z olmang.
scenes.say: Say the English chunk for each one, as fast as you can. Watch the verb.
scenes.say_uz: Har biri uchun inglizcha bo‘lakni imkon qadar tez ayting. Fe’lni kuzating.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kollokatsiyalar
board: 5) have an effect / an impact on
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “make a decision”, Britaniyada “take a decision” ham keng tarqalgan. Ikkinchi: “take a photo”. Uchinchi: “pay attention to”. To‘rtinchi: “do your homework”, “make homework” emas. Beshinchi: “have an effect on” yoki “have an impact on”; “show an influence” emas. Ko‘rib turibsizki, fe’l o‘zbekchaga deyarli hech qachon to‘g‘ri kelmaydi. Shuning uchun bo‘lakni butunligicha yod oling.
scenes.say: Make a decision. Take a photo. Pay attention to. Do your homework. Have an impact on.
scenes.say_uz: Qaror qabul qilmoq. Suratga olmoq. E’tibor bermoq. Uy vazifasini bajarmoq. Ta’sir ko‘rsatmoq.

scenes.title: Tarjimasiz tushuntiring
board: Explain in English, without translating the word:
scenes.say_native: Endi tasvirlash mashqi. Uch o‘zbekcha so‘zni ingliz do‘stingizga tushuntiring, lekin so‘zning o‘zini tarjima qilmang. “It’s a kind of…”, “It’s a place where…”, “It’s made from…” kabi iboralardan foydalaning. Har biriga ikki-uch jumla yetarli. Keyin namuna bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Explain sumalak, mahalla and choyxona to an English friend. Two or three sentences each, no dictionary.
scenes.say_uz: Sumalak, mahalla va choyxonani ingliz do‘stingizga tushuntiring. Har biriga ikki-uch jumla, lug‘atsiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tasvirlash
board: sumalak: a sweet paste made from sprouted wheat, cooked for Navruz
choyxona: a traditional teahouse where people meet and eat
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Sumalak: undirilgan bug‘doydan tayyorlanadigan shirin quyuq taom, Navro‘zda tun bo‘yi pishiriladi. Mahalla: o‘z kengashi va an’analariga ega mahalliy hamjamiyat. Choyxona: odamlar choy ichib, ovqatlanib, suhbatlashadigan an’anaviy choyxona. E’tibor bering, uchala tasvirda ham asl so‘z saqlanib, bir marta tushuntirildi. Bu dasturxon misolidagi strategiyaning o‘zi.
scenes.say: Sumalak is a sweet paste made from sprouted wheat, cooked all night for Navruz. A mahalla is a local neighbourhood community with its own council. A choyxona is a traditional teahouse where people meet, eat and talk.
scenes.say_uz: Sumalak — undirilgan bug‘doydan tayyorlanadigan shirin taom, Navro‘z uchun tun bo‘yi pishiriladi. Mahalla — o‘z kengashiga ega mahalliy hamjamiyat. Choyxona — odamlar uchrashib, ovqatlanib, suhbatlashadigan an’anaviy choyxona.

scenes.title: Talaffuzdagi soxta do‘stlar
scenes.say_native: Soxta do‘stlar talaffuzda ham bor. Xalqaro so‘zlarni o‘zbekcha urg‘u bilan, odatda oxirgi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u berib aytamiz: “internet”, “menejer”, “ekonomika”. Inglizchada esa urg‘u boshqa joyda: “INternet”, “MAnager”, “eCOnomy”, “TECHnology” emas, “techNOlogy”. “Europe” esa “Yevropa” emas, “YUə-rəp”. Bunday so‘zlar tanish bo‘lgani uchun ularni tekshirmaymiz, aynan shuning uchun xato o‘rnashib qoladi.
scenes.say: Internet. Manager. Economy. Technology. Europe. Familiar words, unfamiliar stress. Check them, because they are the ones you never think to check.
scenes.say_uz: Internet. Menejer. Iqtisodiyot. Texnologiya. Yevropa. Tanish so‘zlar, notanish urg‘u. Ularni tekshiring, chunki aynan ularni tekshirish xayolingizga kelmaydi.

scenes.title: Teskari tarjima usuli
board: 2) Put it away for a day
4) Compare: what was lost, added or distorted?
scenes.say_native: Tarjima sifatini tekshirishning professional usuli — teskari tarjima. Matnni inglizchaga o‘giring, bir kun qo‘yib qo‘ying, keyin o‘z inglizchangizni asl matnga qaramasdan o‘zbekchaga qaytaring. So‘ng ikki o‘zbekcha matnni solishtiring: qaysi ma’no yo‘qoldi, qaysi biri qo‘shildi yoki buzildi? Farq qayerda bo‘lsa, muammo o‘sha joyda. Uy vazifangiz aynan shu usulga asoslanadi.
scenes.say: Back-translation is like holding your work up to the light. Wherever the meaning has shifted, you’ll see the crack.
scenes.say_uz: Teskari tarjima ishingizni yorug‘likka tutib ko‘rishga o‘xshaydi. Ma’no qayerda siljigan bo‘lsa, yoriqni o‘sha yerda ko‘rasiz.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: paragraf tarjimasi
board: Bu yerda odamlar juda mehmondo‘st: ko‘chada adashsangiz, kimdir albatta yo‘l ko‘rsatadi.
Boshim osmonga yetdi, desam mubolag‘a bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ekrandagi qisqa paragrafni inglizchaga o‘giring va bugungi barcha strategiyalarni qo‘llang: to‘g‘ri zamon, ega va artikl, uzun jumlani moslash, iborani madaniy muqobil bilan berish. Avval yozing, keyin ovoz chiqarib o‘qing va tabiiy eshitiladimi, tekshiring.
scenes.say: Translate the paragraph. Watch the tense in the first sentence, and don’t let anyone’s head reach the sky.
scenes.say_uz: Paragrafni tarjima qiling. Birinchi jumladagi zamonga e’tibor bering va hech kimning boshi osmonga yetmasin.

scenes.title: Namuna tarjima
board: It’s been three years since I moved to Tashkent.
People here are incredibly hospitable: if you get lost, someone will always show you the way.
It’s no exaggeration to say I couldn’t be happier.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Birinchi jumlada “It’s been three years since I moved” — present perfect va “since”. Ikkinchida “ko‘chada” tushib qoldi, chunki “get lost” uni allaqachon ifodalaydi, “albatta” esa “always” bo‘ldi. Uchinchida “boshim osmonga yetdi” uch yillik holat haqida, shuning uchun “over the moon” emas, “I couldn’t be happier” tanlandi. Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin; muhimi, ma’no saqlansin va matn inglizcha eshitilsin.
scenes.say: It’s been three years since I moved to Tashkent. People here are incredibly hospitable: if you get lost, someone will always show you the way. It’s no exaggeration to say I couldn’t be happier.
scenes.say_uz: Toshkentga kelganimga uch yil bo‘ldi. Bu yerda odamlar nihoyatda mehmondo‘st: adashib qolsangiz, kimdir albatta yo‘l ko‘rsatadi. Boshim osmonga yetdi, desam mubolag‘a bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Think in chunks, paraphrase, plan in English
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: so‘zni emas, ma’noni o‘giring, transpozitsiya va modulyatsiyadan foydalaning, zamon, olmosh va artiklni tekshiring. Ikkinchi: soxta do‘stlarni shaxsiy ro‘yxatda yuriting va bir tilli lug‘atda tekshiring. Uchinchi: maqol va murojaatlarni madaniyatga moslang, kerak bo‘lsa izoh bering. To‘rtinchi: bo‘laklar bilan o‘ylang, bilmagan so‘zni tasvirlang va rejani boshidanoq inglizcha tuzing.
scenes.say: Translate ideas, not words. Distrust familiar-looking words. Respect the reader’s culture. And, more and more, let English do your thinking for you.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zlarni emas, g‘oyalarni o‘giring. Tanish ko‘rinadigan so‘zlarga ishonmang. O‘quvchi madaniyatini hurmat qiling. Va tobora ko‘proq fikrlashni ingliz tiliga topshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: translate a paragraph both ways and compare
Uzbek → English, wait a day, English → Uzbek
Success: list 3 shifts in meaning and fix them
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: 100–150 so‘zli o‘zbekcha paragraf tanlang va uni inglizchaga o‘giring. Bir kundan keyin inglizcha variantingizni asl matnga qaramasdan o‘zbekchaga qaytaring va ikkala o‘zbekcha matnni solishtiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ma’no siljigan kamida uchta joyni topib, sababini yozasiz va inglizcha tarjimani tuzatasiz. Keyingi darsda ilg‘or talaffuz, ya’ni tabiiy nutq oqimini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: translate a paragraph into English, wait a day, translate it back, and compare. Find three places where the meaning shifted, and fix them.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: paragrafni inglizchaga o‘giring, bir kun kuting, uni qaytadan o‘zbekchaga o‘giring va solishtiring. Ma’no siljigan uchta joyni toping va tuzating.

homework_uz: 100–150 so‘zli o‘zbekcha paragrafni inglizchaga o‘giring. Bir kundan keyin inglizcha variantni asl matnga qaramasdan o‘zbekchaga qaytaring va ikki o‘zbekcha matnni solishtiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ma’no siljigan kamida uchta joyni topib, sababini yozing va inglizcha tarjimani tuzating.

quiz.q: Best translation of 'Men bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlayman':
options: I am working here since three years.
I've been working here for three years.
I worked here for three years ago.
quiz.why_uz: “…dan beri” hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat: present perfect continuous + for.

quiz.q: 'This problem is very ___.' (meaning: urgent, much discussed now)
She was very sympathetic means she was:

quiz.why_uz: So‘zma-so‘z emas, ma’no muqobili: “over the moon”.

options: I'm doing pass the exam tomorrow.

quiz.q: Where is the main stress in 'technology'?

options: to check whether meaning was lost or changed
quiz.why_uz: Teskari tarjima ma’no qayerda yo‘qolgan yoki o‘zgarganini ko‘rsatadi.
